spot_check.note: batch is smaller than 80, so every sense is marked spot_check=true

headword_source.why_not_canonical: TD-17 — newgeneralservicelist.com is not in this environment's egress allowlist. Unchanged from 2026-08-07.
headword_source.caveat: UNVERIFIED MIRROR: 2818 headwords vs NGSL v1.2's documented 2809. Only column 1 was read; the mirror's definitions were discarded unread and no definition was copied.
headword_source.provenance_note: Two headwords in this batch sit in the region where the mirror's 9 surplus entries could hide: 'pause' (rank 133) and 'unclear' (rank 140). Both are frequency-plausible artefacts of a spoken corpus (transcription markers), so their NGSL membership is the least certain in this batch. Both are nevertheless real, teachable English words and both are present in the frozen allowed-word file, so neither can cause level drift. Flagged for the Critic.

selection_rule: ascending NGSL frequency rank, skipping any headword that already has a row in data/generated/. Ranks 1-45 and most of 46-278 were taken by the three earlier batches; the 45 most frequent still-uncovered headwords are ranks 46-74 (29 of them, the tail of the grammar block) plus 16 content words scattered through 126-145.
selection_note: 29 of the 45 close the grammar block that batch 2026-08-09 stopped at; the remaining 16 are the first content words the ascending rule reaches. is_function_word is set per SENSE, not per headword — 'no' is a determiner in sense 1 (true) and an interjection in sense 2 (false), and 'still' is a grammatical adverb in sense 1 (true) and a descriptive adjective in sense 2 (false).
sense_policy: D-021 — one row per sense. 19 of the 45 headwords carry two senses (like, when, make, time, see, well, just, no, take, could, use, feel, too, pause, still, talk, great, number, little), so 45 headwords produced 64 rows.
